title: Elon Musk # tweets September 1 - September 8, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from September 1 12:00 PM ET to September 8, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: **Recent posting velocity around 25–35 posts per day, drawn from late-August 2026 activity levels, anchors trader expectations near the 180–219 range for the September 1–8 window.** Trackers and community analyses show Musk maintaining a steady cadence of replies, quotes, and commentary on Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, and platform topics, with modest weekend dips and occasional spikes tied to breaking industry or cultural news. Historical weekly totals have varied widely—sometimes dipping below 150 or surging past 250—creating the tight clustering across adjacent brackets as traders weigh routine business chatter against the potential for any unforeseen developments. With no major product launches, regulatory events, or high-stakes political moments scheduled in the immediate period, the market reflects consensus around typical engagement patterns rather than outlier volume.
